note: Each profile is a complete solver setup. Lessons that produced these values are in memory/cfd.md.

hex-kepsilon.description: Aligned hexahedral meshes: kEpsilon, full corrected solid diffusion, standard relaxation (fixed-demo baseline).

tet-robust.description: Tetrahedral passages: SST with Spalding walls, cell-limited solid gradient, potential-flow velocity start, low momentum/pressure relaxation (manifold fixed-40 case). Note: the cell-limited solid gradient floors the solid h residual near 1e-3; once the field is stable, restart with solid_gradient "Gauss linear" if the residual gate blocks.

tet-robust-slow-energy.description: tet-robust with enthalpy relaxation 0.3 for the first startup chunk when 0.9 diverges; switch to tet-robust via numerical_variant afterwards. Note: the cell-limited solid gradient floors the solid h residual near 1e-3; once the field is stable, restart with solid_gradient "Gauss linear" if the residual gate blocks.

tet-robust-restart.description: tet-robust with the unlimited solid gradient (Gauss linear) for a restart from a settled checkpoint on the same mesh (initialization.fields_from_case). The cellLimited gradient of tet-robust keeps the cold start stable but settles into a limit cycle that floors the solid h residual (1.2e-5 on the manifold at 40 L/min, 2.4e-3 on the bar); unlimited from a settled field converges, unlimited from cold diverged on tet meshes with sharp ribs.

laminar.description: Laminar passages (prescreen Re below 2300): no turbulence model, potential-flow start, unlimited solid gradient (cellLimited floors the solid h residual near 2e-3 on tet meshes), enthalpy relaxation 1.0 (0.9 crawled: e-folding ~3000 iterations on the square-channel bar).
